title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Customer Service skills in Copilot Cowork
summary: Hold: the Service app availability control is incorrectly described as also controlling installation, although Microsoft documents those as independent scopes. The page also says no additional plugin setting is documented despite documenting the user's own toggle and Microsoft's integration control. Most behaviour, licensing and roadmap facts are supported.
